A PRACTICAL FIRST PARTNERSHIP

One hub.
One essentials program.
A measurable pilot.

Bring your coordinators and a small set of nonperishable household essentials. We’ll agree on the workflow, tailor the catalog, and compare the pilot against your current process.

  1. Review a real handoff together.
  2. Agree on scope and baseline measures.
  3. Run the pilot and assess what changed.

A working handoff, end to end.

01 / RECEIVE

Know what is available.

Record donation lots with explicit units, shelf locations, and optional use-by dates. The sample catalog covers six everyday essentials.

02 / MATCH

Make the tradeoffs visible.

Urgent requests go first, then earlier deadlines. Stock is picked by earliest use-by date, while shortages stay visible for the next donation drive.

03 / HAND OFF

Close the loop.

Export a packing list by organization and lot. Confirm the handoff to deduct stock, record fulfillment, and update the remaining queue.

Built for a focused evaluation.

Available in this MVP

  • Interactive stock and request entry
  • Allocation that cannot reuse the same stock in a plan
  • Partial fulfillment and visible shortages
  • Dispatch history and last-dispatch reversal
  • Packing CSV and workspace backup / restore
  • Responsive interface with browser-local storage

Scope for a partnership

  • A paid pilot with your item catalog and branding
  • A white-label license for a defined program
  • A workflow module for a nonprofit software platform
  • Optional integration and shared accounts, scoped separately

This first version serves one coordinator in one browser. It has no shared database, accounts, live integrations, or claimed customer outcomes. No partner relationship is implied by the sample data.

Measure the work, not the promise.

Planning time

Compare the time needed to prepare a checked dispatch list against the coordinator’s current process.

Stock accuracy

Reconcile physical counts with recorded handoffs and note mismatches or unclear units.

Unfilled demand

Review which requests remain short and whether that view helps direct the next collection.

Your data stays with your workspace.

Inventory, organization requests, and handoff records stay in this browser’s local storage. There are no app analytics or tracking cookies. Exported files are saved to your device; keep them somewhere appropriate for your organization. Anyone with access to this browser profile may access the workspace. Clearing browser data removes the saved workspace. Fonts may be requested from Google Fonts, and the hosting provider receives normal web requests.

Use organization-level information only. This MVP is intended for nonperishable household essentials, not medication allocation, individual case management, food-safety decisions, or transport routing. Coordinators remain responsible for checking physical condition, recipient suitability, and the handoff itself.
